messages:
maria: Friendly nudge — PTAL on #4872. I addressed the review comments, split the dep bump into a separate commit, and added a smoke script under tooling/smoke/quick_smoke.sh. CI is green locally and on the ephemeral runner. Ready to merge but need a merge custodian and one more approver.

jon: looking now, thanks. quick q: did you keep the external config shape backward compatible?

maria: yes — kept old keys, added the new ones under an opt-in `routing.v2` block. left comments in the diff about the toggle.

tara: re: merge custody — I can take it if it lands before our freeze at 15:00 PT. Otherwise ping @sam for after the freeze.

sam: I can take it after the freeze. if it lands before, I won’t be online to shepherd the rollout.

jon: small nit: can you add a one-line changelog entry in docs/CHANGELOG.md? makes ops' life easier on call.

maria: done, added under Unreleased > infra. also added a small note in the smoke script about env vars.

deploy-bot: ephemeral CI passed — 12/12 checks. integration-test flake observed on node-pool-3 but reran and passed.

tara: LGTM from me for code — leaving final approve to @jon or @sam depending on time. also, remember to squash the dep-bump commit unless you want it separate for audit.

maria: prefer keeping the dep bump separate for bisectability, so I left it as a separate commit and added a short commit message referencing the ticket.

jon: thanks. I’ll give a formal approve in ~10m after a quick read of the smoke script. if anyone else wants to call a merge window, say now.

maria: thanks all — pinging again in an hour if no movement. :pray:
